ticker_news.title: Jensen Huang Recently Delivered Incredible News for Nvidia Investors
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's new Blackwell GPU architecture is designed to power the growing demand for AI reasoning models, which require significantly more computing power. This could be a significant tailwind for Nvidia's GPU sales, as the top cloud providers have already ordered 3.6 million Blackwell GPUs.
ticker_news.author: Anthony Di Pizio

ticker_news.title: Billionaire David Tepper Is Selling Amazon and Meta Stocks but Betting on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in a Different Way
ticker_news.description: Billionaire David Tepper is reducing his positions in Amazon and Meta, but is investing in Chinese AI stocks like Alibaba and JD.com, as well as utility companies Vistra and NRG Energy, which are benefiting from the growth in data centers supporting AI.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: 2 Top Tech Stocks to Buy in April
ticker_news.description: The article discusses two leading tech companies, Nvidia and Meta Platforms, that investors can buy during the recent stock market sell-off. Nvidia is the market leader in AI chips, and the demand for its GPUs is expected to persist as companies continue to invest in advanced AI models. Meta Platforms is investing heavily in AI through its Llama model, which is improving user engagement and advertising effectiveness on its platforms.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: US Stocks Likely To Open Lower After The Worst Selloff Since 2020: Tariff Announcement Was '100% Smoot Hawley Disguised As Thoughtful Policy,' Says Expert
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday after a broad market selloff on Thursday following the introduction of President Trump's tariffs. Experts criticized the tariffs as a 'Smoot Hawley disguised as thoughtful policy', which caused the market to plummet.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
